fields.name: Afidaxus
fields.desc: A drake of burro-size and long low frame and short broad membraneous wings, sharp of beak and cloaked in thick glittering green-violet scales—scales that cover rows of glands along flanks and spine that exude a sugary wax, sweet, spicy, and entirely edible. If you can get it.

fields.name: Ahauit
fields.desc: The pact was sealed, the contract was signed, and now a menacing figure stands guard over the threshold: flesh the colour of a bruise, gnashing tusks, bulging eyes, a lion’s ears and tail, and two swords carved from darkness.

fields.name: Aurha
fields.desc: Coiling through the air with rippling grace is a sleek viper with blue and silver scales, its tail lined top and bottom with flickering white fin like those of an eel; a good twenty feet or more of cold slitted eyes and silent judgement that watches every motion.

fields.name: Balehound
fields.desc: A terrible whimsy of blackened and wolfish articulated iron, hell-silver etchings across its gleaming plates. Its eyes are glowing lamps; its ragged jaws gape wide, revealing the sorcerous ghostfires inside. The jewel in its brow holds the blood of its intended prey, or that of its master, and it does not reveal which it is.

fields.name: Blazewing
fields.desc: Beautiful, mesmerizing, but dangerous; a butterfly the size of a shield, its wings orange and crimson flame.

fields.name: Bleeding Rose
fields.desc: It’s a rare thing to see a rose briar climb and slither and coil like a snake, piercing with wickedly sharp thorns.

fields.name: Blightwyrm
fields.desc: The whispers from a hideous draconic creature slither through your mind and you swear you can see the beast before it approaches—a serpentine creature of venomous fang and slender, folded forelimbs that look useless compared to the twin clusters of coiling, twisting, barbed tendrils that sprout where wings should be.

fields.name: Bloodwyrm
fields.desc: This weirdly draconic—if you squint—worm-beast is a good twenty feet long, covered in bloody-black chitinous segments, and sports three vicious flanged jaws on its blind, crested maw.

fields.name: Crown-of-Thorns
fields.desc: A strange deer-like creature, long of neck and leg, fleet of foot and rumoured to carry a jewel in its forehead beneath flesh and golden hide. Beware not its coronet of five curving horns; it defends itself with protruding fangs as long and curved as sabres.

fields.name: Dancing Spider
fields.desc: Exactly that, a hand-sized spider of bright green and gold fluff and delicately hooked feet that tap-tap-taps its way to attracting prey—and audiences.

fields.name: Dandelion
fields.desc: Well, yes, the name was given in jest. Less of a joke is this great golden-green feline’s long wooden fangs, or its thorny paws, or—in all honesty—its regal ruffled mane of golden, filamentous petals. The royal beast forgives you.

fields.name: Day-Gone-By
fields.desc: Sometimes magic or just deeply felt events leave behind such an impression on the world, they spawn an insubstantial, intangible echo of that memory or event; a phantom tangle of luminescent self-stuff just waiting for a new home.

fields.name: Deepblue (Caeloni)
fields.desc: This creature of the abyss appears part fish and part serpent, yet swims on two pairs of fleshy fins that match its long, lobed tail.  Buried amongst its ultramarine scales are pearls of marine blessing—but the caeloni is tempramental, loathe to humour land-dwellers.

fields.name: Devil’s Darning Needle
fields.desc: Just a big ol’ red and black dragonfly, never you mind ~ Even if it’s long as your forearm ~ Even if it’s diving at your face with hooked legs and curving abdomen ~

fields.name: Drift-Fractal
fields.desc: Shifting, multicoloured paisley of pulsing energy, this spawn of clashing magics will fend magic away if wrapped in silk.

fields.name: Fallen-From-Grace (Night Mirror)
fields.desc: They say it looks like a conglomeration of delicate refracting black prisms, at first, but no one sees it like that—what they see is a horror that reflects back horrors, before tearing them away from the screaming soul and incorporating them into its ever-shifting form.

fields.name: False Door
fields.desc: What’s worse than a chest that tries to eat you? The moment when you realize that “door” you just waltzed through was a creature’s maw, and now you’re standing in its gullet, and here comes the digestive juices.

fields.name: Fluttering Cherry
fields.desc: Some cherry blossoms flutter free of their bough and tumble on wayward winds to spread their awareness of the ephemeral beauty of the world.

fields.name: Gleaner
fields.desc: Sometimes the folks left out of the harvest don't make it.  Sometimes the land itself is angered by their loss, and nothing will soothe its displeasure until the lost one cuts down and claims their right from flesh instead of seedcorn.  A hungry smile in a withered face; a bloodstained scythe in skeletal hands once thinned with privation.

fields.name: Godling (Small God, Blessed One, etc)
fields.desc: A divine presence sprung from the earth or sky, coalesced from mortal yearning, fissured from some greater godly force, or any of a myriad of origins.  Though a godling be fragile, one may yet work small miracles—and grant power to their greatest adherents, though these followers come to outstrip the source of their granted might.

fields.name: Gorak
fields.desc: A baboon near six feet tall on its hind legs—a baboon of snowy porcelain, its too-smooth ‘hide’ still flecked with gilding here and there, that raises four forepaws in warning of violence to come.

fields.name: Grey Bones
fields.desc: When a skeleton—of any kind—exists long enough, it just might develop a self and a mind and an existence of its own. With age comes wisdom, and deep time, and deeper secrets.

fields.name: Guiding Star
fields.desc: This small, flickering pale flame appears without notice, drifting ghost*like to lead the lost out of their predicament.

fields.name: Heqai
fields.desc: Gliding along the ground—and up walls, and through the very air itself—is a glowing, shimmering shape, as if a snake’s skeleton were formed of countless sorcerous glyphs. And it does so very wish to add ever more to its sinuous calligraphic spine.

fields.name: Ii’ama (Marine-snow)
fields.desc: It looks just like a few drifting clumps of snow in the water, or maybe some broken chunks of ice—then the translucent, scaly beast surges forward with a snap of its flippers to snatch prey with a fang-filled maw at the end of its long, long neck.

fields.name: Little People
fields.desc: A glimpse of a gnarled figure barely hip*high, sporting red vest or cap—or a glimmer in the air—or a curious, magnificent, tack-less horse—or a whisper on the wind, teasing…

fields.name: Living Eclipse
fields.desc: A spherical void cut into the world, or extruding into it; a dancing white-hot—or is it ice-cold?—coronal flame crawling eternally across its surface. None know its source. None know what it wants.

fields.name: Malocophony
fields.desc: A strange sight glides through the air: a conglomeration of dozens of blades of stained glass, like a fireworks of glittering black-trimmed wings was frozen in time. As it approaches, a soothing chiming hum begins to resonate…

fields.name: Malspell
fields.desc: For a brief moment there was a red-rimmed shadow of a twisted, broken glyph; but now it’s gone—and now each spell cast is warped and wounding.

fields.name: Melodi (Song Elemental)
fields.desc: A whirl of emotion and rhythm, of harmonics and colours felt more than seen; from a tangle of phantom notes all the way to a tempest of notations from a thousand worlds, all singing in unearthly harmony—

fields.name: Narhistrix
fields.desc: If compared to any creature, this jowly and foul-tempered beast is most like a massive, rippling hog—but a hog sporting thick claws instead of split hooves, and a snarling maw of shearing fangs instead of a hog’s upturned snout. Its arched back bristles with quills, and its speed belies its massive girth.

fields.name: Neep
fields.desc: An ambulatory turnip?  Yes. (Sometimes a carrot.)  A large ambulatory turnip with luxuriant greens, a lopsided face, and spindly rootlet limbs sprouting from its tubery body.  Kind of a joke, until an entire garden patch uproots themselves and chase you.

fields.name: Nurturer
fields.desc: Big jelly.  Big big jelly.  A big jelly that heals, and soothes, and offers comfort to the creatures that slip inside its pinkish*amber mass, while it feeds off all that makes them hurt, body and soul, in return.  And oh how they will defend their unlikely haven.

fields.name: Old Hag
fields.desc: You might catch a glimpse, in the mind’s eye, while you lie in the dark at night. Most likely all you know is the weight on your chest and the hell in your head and you can’t move—

fields.name: Quivering Jelly
fields.desc: There’s something almost hypnotic about the way this multicoloured, prismatic jelly shivers and sparkles…

fields.name: Rainsnail
fields.desc: A strange little half-elemental creature; a snail the size of one’s noggin, grey-blue with pearly striped shell, just gliding along encased in a bubble of water.

fields.name: Ram-In-Wolf’s-Clothing (Flinthorn Sheep)
fields.desc: Not your average woolie beastie, this sheep sports a short, tightly curled fleece of mottled grey and dun, disturbingly intelligent eyes, and a pair of broad spiralling horns that spread wide before curling forward in wickedly sharp points.

fields.name: Revok
fields.desc: That’s a pretty, and pretty unhesitating, mirage plodding slowly your way—a tortoise tall as an ox, scaled in velvety black with every plate and scute that encases it a gleaming mirror, its shell rising in tall irregular peaks of shining mirrored crystals.

fields.name: Rollsnail
fields.desc: What snail moves fast enough to trip you up? One as big as a grapefruit with a shell just as round, and a habit of flicking the ground with its foot to pick up speed.

fields.name: Salamandrach
fields.desc: Slick, coal-black skin peppered with sulphur-yellow chitin; a creature with a distinctly amphibious look to its wide maw and round eyes and grasping toes, that conflicts in the mind with its long segmented body and hundred skittering legs.

fields.name: Sau
fields.desc: A living armour, spiked and bladed and horned; a cuirass of glittering chitin and metal-shot ligament that fits like a second skin, absorbing blows and granting new means of offense.  A sau can be commanded to fight as an empty shell, but the control is taxing to its owner.

fields.name: Smoke-and-Mirror
fields.desc: A butterfly, large and showy, all of deepest translucent obsidian flutters by.

fields.name: The Cold Hare
fields.desc: These icy bunnies are bad news in a field or anywhere else; where they den down, it grows winter-cold, creeping bit by bit with each passing night.

fields.name: Trisakh (Triune Wolves, Threefangs)
fields.desc: Three canine creatures watch your every move.  They look like wolves; long-legged wolves, sleek and speedy, with smooth coats of steel-tipped black.  Above three pairs of lupine ears, a multicoloured flame hovers; in three pairs of icy lupine eyes, uncanny, savage wisdom.  And then they move as one.

fields.name: Urugotha
fields.desc: Bad enough that the thing looks like some unholy amalgamation of slug and leech and rotting meat, but the wretched creatures spawn endlessly and spread their filth besides.

fields.name: Uruke (Creeping Bolete)
fields.desc: Glossy rusty brown mushrooms as tall as a grown adult. Well, it could be worse, right…like if they started to slowly walk about, and gather corpses. Maybe make some. Oh dear.

fields.name: Wadjwer (Great Green)
fields.desc: A dragon—a great dragon, thick with bulk yet still sinuous in its movements as it strides, coiling, across the land. Its scales moss and malachite and jade, or jasper and copper and carnelian; its horns gnarled and branched and burnished golden brown; and both its broad back and spade*like tail are overgrown with bone-spur trellises covered with berry-vines, young trees loaded with fine fruits, and every herb and leaf and green-growing thing one could wish for—

fields.name: Whim-rune
fields.desc: A chiselled shape of near-invisible magic—until it changes its perch in a shimmer of rainbow light. May be contained inside stone.

fields.name: Yukanen
fields.desc: What looked like ripples in the lake—like a cresting wave—suddenly takes to the air: a furious raptor of whirling, foam-flecked teal blue water. Its eyes are like twin pearls, and talons of razor-sharp ice flash as it dives.
